title: $\mathcal{O}(αα_s^2)$ corrections to the Top Quark mass
summary: We calculate the three-loop $\mathcal{O}(αα_s^2)$ mixed QCD-EW corrections to the top quark mass and obtain the relationships between the pole ($M_t$) and $\overline{\rm{MS}}$ ($m_t(μ)$) masses at this order. In performing our calculation, we express the three-loop self-energies as a function of three-loop master integrals (MIs). These MIs are defined so as to solve a differential equation in $ε$-factorized form, allowing for their solution to be expressed as iterated integrals.
